verdict.rationale: Archiving received service-of-process documents for later retrieval is a fair question for a registered-agent service like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing the site was walled off by a Cloudflare challenge, with no product content about document archiving or retention.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
